**Exclude doc-comment text from `literalRegex` matching.**

`Form::lex` turns doc comments into ordinary string-literal leaves whose spans cover the original comments. This branch decodes and matches those leaves, so a `http://` pattern can match documentation prose. Skip leaves whose source span starts with `/`; explicit `#[doc = "..."]` literals remain eligible.
